objs.name: policy
objs.description: Company-wide regulation and process at strategic level (e.g. code of conduct, travel expenses policy, ICS policy, process and organizational structure)

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document abbreviation identifier

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the policy

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status in the release workflow

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document that describes locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document abbreviation identifier

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the guideline

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status in the release workflow

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Detailed documentation of specific work steps and procedures within a framework, including sub-processes, test instructions, and compliance criteria

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document abbreviation identifier

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the work instruction

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status in the release workflow

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document describing specific procedures within a framework, process sequence, details and responsible persons to achieve an objective

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document abbreviation identifier

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the procedural instruction

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status in the release workflow

objs.name: document
objs.description: Generic document object that can be of various types managed in the P&R management system

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Document abbreviation identifier

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status in the release workflow

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document is valid

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Expiration date of the document validity

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Period for which extended validity check is necessary

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which document is archived before physical deletion

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attachment subject to the release cycle of the main document with its own versioning

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status in the release workflow

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Document supplemental content not subject to the release cycle of the main document

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Flag indicating if additional information is published

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Pre-defined template used for creating new documents of a specific type

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Office format (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposed amendment to an existing document without affecting content or version history

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal

attributes.name: implementation_scheduled
attributes.description: Flag indicating if change proposal is scheduled for implementation

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-generated request for reviewing document validity when approaching expiration date

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate and archive a document that has no additional validity

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to re-validate a previously invalidated document

objs.name: author
objs.description: User role responsible for creating and editing document content

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: User assigned additional personal change rights to a document without relevance in release workflow

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: User role responsible for checking document content according to technical and formal aspects

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: User role responsible for approving and releasing document for distribution to readers

objs.name: reader
objs.description: User role with permission to view approved documents

objs.name: translator
objs.description: User role responsible for translating released document content into other languages

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: User group with read access to archived documents

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: User group permitted to create reactivation requests

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Collection of users assigned to specific roles and permissions

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: User group identifier

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature applied by workflow participant in document release process

attributes.name: participant
attributes.description: User who applied the signature

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of signature

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by distributed user that they have received and noted the document

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether acknowledgement has been confirmed

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to receive document distribution

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attachment of new document object to the system with selection of document type and template

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modification of document content using editing client in MS Office format

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Definition and maintenance of standardized and customer-specific metadata and attributes

evts.name: maintain_authorization
evts.description: Assignment of group and person-related authorizations for document access and modification

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Attachment of external file or document to a document object

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic conversion of document from source format to PDF after saving

evts.name: initiate_release_workflow
evts.description: Starting of 3-step approval process consisting of Creator, Review, and Release stages

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Application of electronic signature by workflow participant during release process

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check of document content by reviewer according to technical and formal aspects

evts.name: approve_document
evts.description: Final approval and release decision by releaser for distribution to readers

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of released document making it visible to addressed readers

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: Rejection of document during review or release workflow stage

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Automatic creation of new version when editing released document

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of attachment for archiving during document revision

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of proposed amendment to document without affecting content or version history

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Scheduling and implementation of change proposal creating new document version

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Marking of change proposal as completed and no longer displayed in document

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Automatic system generation of validity extension request when document approaches expiration

evts.name: check_validity_extension
evts.description: Review of document validity by releaser or all release participants

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Approval of extended validity updating Valid Until date by default validity period

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Creation of new version of document for content updates or modifications

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Creation of request to invalidate document with no additional validity

evts.name: check_override
evts.description: Review and verification of override request by specified participants

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Official invalidation of document and its attachments with archiving

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Creation of request to re-validate previously invalidated document

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Approval of reactivation creating new version of invalidated document

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Notification of assigned users and user groups upon release of new document version

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Workflow-supported request for active confirmation of document acknowledgement by distributed users

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Active confirmation by user that they have received and noted the document

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of released document content into another language

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check of translated document content by reviewer

evts.name: approve_translation
evts.description: Release approval of translated document by releaser

evts.name: publish_translation
evts.description: Publication of released translation making document visible in target language

evts.name: physical_delete_document
evts.description: Permanent deletion of archived document after archive period expiration

o2o.description: Document has attachments that are released with the main document
Document is supplemented with additional information
Change proposal belongs to and is managed for a document
Document template is selected when creating new document
Document has signatures from workflow participants
Validity extension request is linked to document for validity check
Override request is created for invalidation of document
Reactivation request selects document for re-validation
Document has distribution list of assigned users and user groups
Document has acknowledgements from distributed users
Policy is a type of document
Guideline is a type of document
Work Instruction is a type of document
Procedural Instruction is a type of document
Author creates and edits document content
Co-author has additional change rights on document
Reviewer checks document content
Releaser approves and releases document
Reader views approved documents
Translator translates released document content
User group contains authors
User group contains reviewers
User group contains releasers
User group contains readers
User group contains translators

o2e.description: Release workflow is initiated for document
New version of document is created
Change proposal is created for document
Validity extension request is created for document
Validity extension of document is checked
Override request is created for document
Reactivation request is created for document
